activationOrder: Explicit owner activation instruction; snapshot code, current runs, labels and exact dev/main refs; resolve actual default branch and local hook config.
Keep PROCESS_NEXT_ENABLED false and remote config.enabled false; install reviewed templates inertly on dev and event-delivery/default branch.
Drain old in-flight merge/review actions; disable old A entry workflows on both branches before enabling new coordinator. Do not cancel an unknown in-flight Git write.
Apply A hook/package/workflow replacements as one switch; initialize queue state explicitly; configure credentials and explicit owner-decision provenance.
Enable A only after queue wakeup/finish/status and post-merge dev-build retry are connected. Observe one real authorized task; no blanket full product run is added.
Connect background mutation schedule separately; never use its result as a task or release gate.
Before B, resolve reviewed golden differences, reduce mixed dependencies, seed published beta/stable state, configure release/HACS access and preserve applicable runner cache.

Disable old B publication/derived-review entry workflows before enabling new release commands. Apply one canonical golden runner and replace aliases; remove _service-event only after every old caller is gone.

Publish only on an explicit owner release command; retain immutable tag/source/digests and queue the published stable/hotfix tag back to dev. Any workflow-only commit on main must also enter dev before a later release candidate.
After each stage, remove only the now-unreachable old mechanism files and their retired tests; leave manual product utilities and unrelated user hooks intact.
rollback: Disable new coordinator/fallback/review activation; stop accepting new queue entries and new publication commands.
Wait for or inspect any in-flight atomic push/publication; read actual refs, release assets and state. Never infer failure from a missing label/comment.

Revert only cutover code/config changes with a normal commit; restore old entry workflows and hook/package files from the recorded pre-switch revision. Do not reset dev/main or move/delete published tags.
Keep new queue/release state and runner reports for reconciliation. Already merged S8 tasks and published candidates stay completed; never replay them as unmerged work.
Reconcile unfinished tasks explicitly, then enable one coordinator family. Restore core.hooksPath only in checkouts where this cutover changed it; do not overwrite unrelated configuration.
verificationBoundary: Manifest and documentation only. Read-only inventory of current files and dependency references; no workflow installation, API changes, hook edits, live publication or activation performed.
